description: In SolveSpace, create a 2D rectangular sketch and extrude it to create a 3D solid block. First, in the blank canvas draw a rectangle using the Rectangle tool (Sketch > Rectangle, shortcut R). Add dimension constraints (Constrain > Distance / Diameter, shortcut D) to set the width to 40mm and height to 30mm. Then create a new extrude group via the Group menu → New Group → Extrude to extrude the sketch in the Z direction to create a 3D solid. Save the resulting 3D model as '/home/ga/Documents/SolveSpace/block.slvs' using File > Save.
